note: Paraphrased from Valdy's 2025-12 to 2026-04 civ guides on YouTube. Shown in every brief before the game.

openingReads.means: A spear rush is coming. Don't overreact: secure your gold, go Feudal and make archers.
A second Town Center. Punish it with pressure or out-boom it.

openingReads.sign: Villagers on gold with a tower and no production buildings
openingReads.means: A fast Castle. Wall up and go Castle yourself, or tower their gold.
Pro Scouts. They'll take deer, so guard yours.
Usually a fast Castle. On food, it usually means units are coming.

habits: A tower on its own doesn't prove a fast Castle.
Never delete straggler trees, and use map food before farms.
Castle Age usually lands around 12 minutes. Plan your army around it.
Don't sit in base with an aggressive or two-Town-Center build.
Archers beat spears, spears beat cavalry, knights beat archers and heavy infantry, crossbows beat armor. Knight, spear and archer covers most things in Castle.
